offer: InboxLift is a cold-email deliverability platform: automated mailbox warm-up, inbox placement tests and domain-health monitoring, so outbound teams land in the primary inbox and book more meetings from the same send volume.
icp: B2B SaaS companies with 20-500 employees in North America, UK or EU, Seed to Series C, running an outbound sales motion with at least 3 SDRs/AEs sending cold email.

personas.economic_buyer: VP Sales, Head of Sales, CRO or founder-led sales; owns pipeline budget
personas.champion: Sales Ops / RevOps manager or Head of Sales Development; owns the outbound tool stack
personas.user: SDR, BDR or AE who sends cold email daily

exclusions: Lead-gen and cold-email agencies, freelancers, students, recruiters, companies under 5 employees, B2C and e-commerce brands, government and education.
timing: Do not reach out in late December, during a public layoff or acquisition, or within 90 days of a customer churning from us.

signals.funding: true when the company raised Seed to Series B in the last 6 months and is B2B
signals.hiring: true when the posted role contacts prospects directly (SDR, BDR, AE, head of sales development). Account managers and sales engineers are false
signals.job_change: true when the person took a new, more senior role in sales or revenue operations in the last 90 days

competitors: Other deliverability or warm-up tools (warm-up networks, inbox placement testers), cold-email sending platforms that bundle warm-up, and cold-email agencies that resell deliverability services.
